responsibility: This file exposes selected build- and installation-dependent configuration values to the gm2 frontend, chiefly the path resolution logic for the C preprocessor executable. It combines GCC configuration macros such as STANDARD_LIBEXEC_PREFIX and target triples with Modula-2 options like -B and cpp enablement to synthesize the full path to cc1/cpp support programs used during preprocessing.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file that actually computes the executable path for the preprocessor/cc1 using STANDARD_LIBEXEC_PREFIX, target triples, and M2Options_GetB/GetCpp. The corresponding .def and .h files merely expose that resolver and related configuration surface.
